what: Fixed on-screen camera viewfinder — four corner brackets (25–40px), a center aiming box with crosshair, REC at the top right and thin vertical lines on both sides, overlaid on every section with exclusion blend so the whole page looks like it is being filmed. When the top header slides down, it shrinks beneath it in .5s — for video, photo and shooting-related sites.

options.top: Descending headband css — shrinks beneath it while visible (default none, whole screen)
options.rec: If off, the REC indicator is not drawn
options.--fx-x: Left and right margins (via style), default clamp(15px, …, 65px)
options.[data-fx-part=corner]: Corner brackets (data-key 1~4) — drawn in if missing
options.[data-fx-part=center]: Center aim — drawn in if missing
options.[data-fx-part=rec]: REC indicator — drawn in if missing

from.where: shared.js every page [data-slot=viewfinder] Viewfinder fixed to the screen
